title: REQ · AdminApp shows an error message when an execution action fails
summary: Failed execution actions show a message in the Execution region and 401 returns to the token gate
description: When an execution action rejects, AdminApp stores the message in an actionError state and passes it as the actionError prop to ExecutionPanel, which renders it with role alert. A 401 still returns to the token gate. A later successful action clears the message.
acceptance_criteria: Given the approve endpoint answers 500, when Approve is clicked, then the Execution region shows an alert containing the error message
Given an action endpoint answers 401, when a button is clicked, then the token gate is shown with 'Invalid token'
Given a previous action failed, when a later action succeeds, then the action error is no longer shown

preserve: top-level error paragraph for load failures

technical_constraints: Use the existing actionError prop of ExecutionPanel
definition_of_done: Errors shown and verified by unit tests
